IS 4910 : Part 11 : 2024 Tyre Yarns, Cords and Tyre Cord Fabrics Made from Man-Made Fibres - Methods of Test - Part 11 Commercial Mass

TXD 38

1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard (Part 11) prescribes methods for determination of commercial mass of consignments of man-made fibres, tyre yarns, cords and tyre cord fabrics.
1.1.1 This standard is applicable to dipped as well as undipped material.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards:
